notes: Single style on the page. Year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits, month = 3rd & 4th numerical digits (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Serial is all digits, so character and digit counting agree. Page example 850304091 decodes to March 1985. No held styles on this page; page image is a date-of-manufacture photo, not a decode chart. Kept separate from Sun Glow and Sunburst, which have their own pages. Same shape as those brands' styles is not a collision: decode is brand-scoped.
